study.question: Can replacing the self-inclusive feedback background with the same visible prefix excluding the current slot improve the centered relation-content/count-shrinkage model beyond g2-r0011-center_count and both frozen source bests, at matched parameters and measured cost? Does any benefit require within-slot event-feedback covariance, or is a centered mean-product sufficient?
study.hypothesis: Observed implementation limitation: g2-r0011-center_count uses each slot in its own smoothing and centering reference. For nonempty slot s with occupancy n and total N, r_s-b_user = (1-n/N)*(r_s-b_outside) when N>n. Thus self-inclusion attenuates the between-slot feedback contrast, particularly for dominant slots. This is a source-code/algebra observation; the dataset prevalence and predictive importance of dominant slots have not been measured. In exact arithmetic the current centered joint channel is alpha*[Cov_s(Wx,y)+mu_s*(r_s-b_user)], alpha=n/(n+4). Replacing b_user with b_outside in BOTH smoothing and centering selectively restores the between-slot term while leaving covariance and raw fractions unchanged. Hypothesis: this can expose useful target-relation feedback differences with no added capacity. The outside reference is a disjoint same-user event set, NOT an independent prior, mature online feedback estimate, calibrated uncertainty, or causal counterfactual. It may instead amplify noise. All four new arms fix count weighting and user centering; a background-reference x joint/factorized factorial identifies whether covariance contributes to any gain. Originality remains unverified.

study.proposed_difference: Implement _feedback_background from FP32 integer-valued masked task sums BEFORE division into fractions. Compute inclusive b_user=sum(y)/max(N,1) and complementary b_minus_s=(sum(y)-sum_s(y))/max(N-n_s,1). Where N=n_s, fall back to b_user; for an entirely empty prefix both are zero. Select complement or inclusive via a scalar switch after computing both. Use the chosen [B,8,4] background consistently in the inherited smoothed gate and centering offset. Cross this reference with moment_mode joint versus factorized; all arms still compute covariance, with only its scalar multiplier varying. Centered joint is approximately alpha*(J_s-mu_s*b); centered factorized is approximately alpha*mu_s*(r_s-b), allowing BF16 mean/projection rounding. Exclusion introduces no new information: it is a deterministic re-expression of authorized slot/global statistics and selective occupancy-dependent scaling of the between-slot term, NOT blanket rescaling of covariance. Raw fractions stay unsmoothed. Candidate and all controls are standalone modules with AST-identical executable structure outside literal CONFIG. No context modules from round 12 are retained.
predictions: Primary predictive prediction: exclude_joint has higher full-validation four-task macro AUC than inclusive_joint and the archived incumbent 0.8280959704981011, and exceeds both imported source bests 0.8275704845768582 and 0.8272805336635536. This is untested. Select by the frozen equal-weight macro AUC, then macro Logloss, parameters and trial ID; report all four AUC/Logloss changes against baseline-din, both sources and incumbent without a new task veto.

Mechanistic predictions before training: with no outside events, inclusive and excluded features coincide; empty slots remain zero; with equal feedback rates inside/outside the background switch has no effect; otherwise exclusion changes only the between-slot component and preserves alpha*covariance. In exact arithmetic joint-minus-factorized equals alpha*covariance under either background. A same-marginal different-pairing synthetic contrast affects the covariance path, while the reference intervention acts through slot/global feedback counts.

Interpret the factorial using delta_bg_joint=AUC(exclude_joint)-AUC(inclusive_joint), delta_bg_factorized=AUC(exclude_factorized)-AUC(inclusive_factorized), and their difference. Positive background effects in both moment modes support utility of the reference transformation but do not require covariance. A positive interaction and a positive joint-versus-factorized contrast would provisionally support complementary joint-event content. No single run establishes a mechanism.

Use the host-available predeclared empty/1-16/17-64/>64 history-length slices with sample, positive and negative counts for all tasks. Empty-history auxiliary counts (45/28/13 positives for cart/fav/buy) make those AUC contrasts unstable. Existing incumbent macro slice AUCs are 0.721273545/0.777570584/0.804639055/0.850704389. falsifiers: A reproducible nonpositive exclude_joint-minus-inclusive_joint macro AUC difference, or failure to beat the incumbent, opposes added predictive utility of this tested reference replacement. Do not select it simply for exceeding the weaker source. One unsuccessful implementation does not refute every complementary-reference design.

If excluded and inclusive factorized arms explain the same gain and joint does not improve over factorized, do not attribute the result to added event-feedback coupling. If only one arm or task improves, report the interaction and task trade-offs without a general compatibility claim.

If paired host repetitions reverse the effect or paired user-cluster uncertainty includes material regressions, retain preliminary/uncertain status. Same-seed calibration reruns are not additional mechanism contrasts or independent confirmations.

Nonfinite output/gradients, wrong task order, masked-payload sensitivity, mismatch to the inclusive parent under shared state, changed parameter/init contract, or failure of outside-empty fallback invalidates the implementation pending diagnosis. A runtime failure is not scientific counterevidence against the hypothesis.

Material additional measured training/inference cost without a quality benefit opposes efficiency utility even though nominal parameters and operation shapes match. No equal-compute claim follows merely from a matched recipe.
alternative_explanations: A gain may be occupancy-dependent feature scaling/optimization under a one-pass recipe rather than improved reliability or additional information. Complement statistics are algebraically recoverable from existing counts/rates; this study claims only inductive-bias utility.

The outside group may be tiny, have another category/brand or lie mostly in the other recency band. Its rate can be a biased/noisy comparator; exclusion need not improve calibration. No prior independence or causal meaning is established.

The best incumbent gain over entry is 0.0005254859212429 macro AUC and over its absolute-moment control only 0.0000348114972148. Adaptive validation search, seed variation, Dice statistics and BF16 rounding can dominate new small effects.

Inherited action embeddings and relation counts overlap with explicit feedback statistics; remaining redundancy or shared-gradient effects may explain the weak covariance/centering gains. The four arms preserve this redundancy for isolation.

Auxiliary cart/fav/buy labels match user/category/brand in the following 24h rather than direct advertisement conversion. Offline delayed-feedback visibility and publisher static/vocabulary assumptions restrict deployment transfer.

Earlier source comparisons have different capacities, so their deltas are quality/cost context, not isolated causal evidence for this small reference change. Original-method novelty remains unverified because source coverage is incomplete.
